title: BlendOps Canonical Typed Runtime Operations Registry

governance_summary.external_runtime_ownership: BlendOps does not own or ship a Blender runtime, MCP server, or Blender add-on. External runtimes (Path 1 Official Blender Lab MCP 5.1+ and Path 2 Community mcp-for-blender 3.0+) own Blender execution; BlendOps governs typed operation planning, capability preflight, pre-mutation .blend checkpoints, independent readback, and truthful evidence.
governance_summary.capability_tier_distinction: Every BlendOps skill operates at capabilityTier = L0 (planning/validation content layer), while governedRuntimeCeiling (L0-L3) bounds the maximum external runtime operation tier that skill may authorize.

blocked_arbitrary_interfaces.reason: Unrestricted Python or raw bpy code passthrough (including raw user-facing execute_blender_code prompts) is prohibited as a BlendOps operation.
Arbitrary shell commands and unvalidated CLI flags cannot be invoked through the typed runtime operation surface.
Destructive multi-object deletion, arbitrary filesystem writes outside allowlisted directories, and unbacked scene resets are blocked.

operations.purpose: Read active Blender file path status, add-on readiness, and session bridge metadata without modifying the scene.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP path info inspection via Anthropic Connector host.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP path info inspection via manual MCP host.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Read-only community mcp-for-blender add-on status inspection.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected and single-bridge verified.

required_postconditions.description: Response includes saved/dirty state and filepath without mutating the scene.

known_limitations: Path 1 get_blendfile_summary_path_info does not always include the exact blender --version string unless queried from session metadata.

operations.purpose: Inspect the active .blend file path, saved state, and datablock counts (scenes, objects, meshes, materials, cameras, lights).

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Datablock counts and active scene name are returned without scene modification.

known_limitations: Path 2 get_scene_info summarizes active scene objects rather than global unused datablocks.

operations.purpose: Inspect active scene name, render engine, world lighting state, and active object.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Scene name, render engine, and object count are present.

known_limitations: Read-only summary does not evaluate geometry modifier stacks.

operations.purpose: Retrieve the list of objects in the active scene with their types, visibility, and world transforms.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Array of scene objects with name, type, and visibility is returned.

known_limitations: Does not create or rename missing objects; reports exact scene inventory.

operations.purpose: Inspect triangle, vertex, face, and UV map counts for target mesh objects against platform budgets.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP object/mesh summary inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP object/mesh summary inspection.

required_preconditions.description: Target mesh object must exist in the scene.

required_postconditions.description: Triangle and vertex counts are returned as non-negative integers.

known_limitations: Reports evaluated or base mesh counts depending on upstream tool detail payload.

operations.display_name: Inspect Material Slots & Principled BSDF Parameters
operations.purpose: Inspect assigned material slots and Principled BSDF roughness/metallic/base_color parameters on an object.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP material datablock inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP material datablock inspection.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Read-only community get_object_info material slot inspection.

required_preconditions.description: Target object must exist in the active scene.

required_postconditions.description: Material slot list is returned without mutating shader nodes.

known_limitations: Custom procedural node groups are summarized by top-level slot name.

operations.purpose: Inspect active camera transform, focal length, DOF settings, and scene light energy/color/transform parameters.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP camera and lighting inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP camera and lighting inspection.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Read-only community camera and light inspection.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Camera and light state arrays are returned without mutating the scene.

known_limitations: Reports existing cameras and lights only; does not synthesize missing rigs.

operations.display_name: Inspect Render Engine, Resolution & Color Management
operations.purpose: Inspect active render engine (CYCLES or BLENDER_EEVEE), output resolution, sample budget, and AgX/Filmic view transform.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP render settings inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP render settings inspection.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Render engine, resolution, and view transform are returned.

known_limitations: Eevee identifier is BLENDER_EEVEE on Blender 5.x and BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT on Blender 4.2-4.x.

operations.display_name: Inspect Scene Hierarchy & Transform Scale Hygiene
operations.purpose: Inspect parent-child relationships, collection organization, and non-uniform or negative scale anomalies.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Root objects and scale hygiene lists are returned.

known_limitations: Does not automatically apply transforms; flags unapplied or negative scale for preflight.

operations.display_name: Inspect Animation Clips, NLA Tracks & Armature Metadata
operations.purpose: Inspect action datablocks, NLA strips, frame range, and armature skinning presence prior to GLB animation handoff.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP action/armature datablock inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP action/armature datablock inspection.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Action count, armature count, and frame range are returned.

known_limitations: Does not bake constraints or NLA strips during L0 inspection.

operations.display_name: Inspect GLB Export Readiness (Zero File Write)
operations.purpose: Verify missing external textures, linked libraries, scale hygiene, and PBR compatibility before any GLB export is attempted.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP missing-files and linked-library check.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Read-only Lab MCP missing-files and linked-library check.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Read-only community scene and object GLB readiness check.

required_preconditions.description: External MCP runtime session must be connected.

required_postconditions.description: Readiness report is returned with zero files written to disk.

known_limitations: Does not perform a .glb file export; evaluates scene readiness only.

operations.display_name: Update Existing Camera Transform & Lens Settings
operations.purpose: Apply bounded, reversible location, Euler rotation, focal length (mm), and DOF focus distance updates to an existing camera after a verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Constrained camera property update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint; never exposes raw Python to the user.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Constrained camera property update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint; never exposes raw Python to the user.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Constrained camera property update on Path 2 after verified .blend checkpoint; never exposes raw Python to the user.

required_preconditions.description: Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist on disk with verified byteSize > 0 and SHA-256.
Target camera_name must already exist in the scene as a CAMERA object.

required_postconditions.description: Independent readback confirms camera location, rotation_euler_deg, and focal_length_mm match requested values within tolerance (0.001).

known_limitations: Only updates an existing camera datablock; never creates or deletes cameras.

operations.display_name: Update Existing Light Energy, Color & Transform
operations.purpose: Apply bounded, reversible energy (Watts), RGB color, size, and transform updates to an existing light object after a verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Constrained light parameter update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Constrained light parameter update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Constrained light parameter update on Path 2 after verified .blend checkpoint.

required_preconditions.description: Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist on disk with verified byteSize > 0 and SHA-256.
Target light_name must already exist in the scene as a LIGHT object.

required_postconditions.description: Independent readback confirms light energy_watts and color_rgb match requested values within tolerance (0.001).

known_limitations: Only updates an existing LIGHT object; never creates duplicate lights.

operations.display_name: Update Existing Material Principled BSDF Properties
operations.purpose: Apply bounded updates to allowlisted Principled BSDF inputs (base_color_rgba, metallic, roughness, ior) on an existing material.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Constrained Principled BSDF parameter update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Constrained Principled BSDF parameter update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Constrained Principled BSDF parameter update on Path 2 after verified .blend checkpoint.

required_preconditions.description: Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist on disk with verified byteSize > 0 and SHA-256.
Target object and material slot must exist in the scene.

required_postconditions.description: Independent readback confirms roughness and metallic values match requested inputs.

known_limitations: Only updates scalar/color inputs on an existing Principled BSDF material; does not rewire arbitrary shader graphs.

operations.display_name: Update Existing Object Transform (Positive Scale Guarded)
operations.purpose: Apply bounded location, Euler rotation, and positive scale updates to an existing scene object after a verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Constrained object transform update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Constrained object transform update on Path 1 after verified .blend checkpoint.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Constrained object transform update on Path 2 after verified .blend checkpoint.

required_preconditions.description: Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist on disk with verified byteSize > 0 and SHA-256.
Target object_name must already exist in the scene.

required_postconditions.description: Independent readback confirms object location, rotation, and positive scale match requested values.

known_limitations: Rejects negative scale components to prevent inverted mesh normals in downstream GLB exports.

operations.display_name: Render Still Image to Governed Output Directory
operations.purpose: Render a still frame to an allowlisted output path and verify the produced file byteSize and SHA-256 on disk.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Writes still image to allowlisted path via Lab MCP render_viewport_to_path.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Writes still image to allowlisted path via Lab MCP render_viewport_to_path.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Governed still render to allowlisted output directory on Path 2.

required_preconditions.description: target_output_path must resolve inside output_directory_allowlist without path traversal.
Pre-export .blend checkpoint must be verified before invoking L2 export.

required_postconditions.description: Rendered image file exists on disk with byte_size > 0 and 64-hex SHA-256.

known_limitations: Separately gated at L2; deferred from the initial L0/L1 vertical slice unless L2 is explicitly granted.

operations.display_name: Export GLB 2.0 Container to Governed Output Directory
operations.purpose: Export a binary .glb file to an allowlisted directory and validate its binary GLB 2.0 container and glTF semantics.

path-1-host-a.mutation_transport_note: Governed GLB 2.0 export to allowlisted directory followed by binary GLB inspection.

path-1-host-b.mutation_transport_note: Governed GLB 2.0 export to allowlisted directory followed by binary GLB inspection.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Governed GLB 2.0 export on Path 2 followed by binary GLB inspection.

cli-appendix.mutation_transport_note: Headless CLI appendix GLB export on Blender 4.5+.

required_preconditions.description: target_output_path must end with .glb and resolve inside output_directory_allowlist.
Pre-export .blend checkpoint must be verified on disk.

required_postconditions.description: Exported .glb passes binary container and semantic inspection (magic glTF, version 2).

known_limitations: Separately gated at L2; requires binary GLB 2.0 inspection before claiming Produced/Verified.

operations.purpose: Import an external asset only after asset-license-checker clearance and a verified pre-mutation .blend checkpoint.

path-2-community.mutation_transport_note: Uses Path 2 import_asset only after SPDX/category license clearance and .blend backup.

required_preconditions.description: Asset must carry Cleared license status from asset-license-checker.
Pre-mutation .blend checkpoint must exist and be SHA-256 verified on disk.

required_postconditions.description: Independent scene readback confirms the imported asset datablock exists in the scene.

known_limitations: External asset import tool (import_asset) is only exposed on Path 2 community mcp-for-blender and remains gated at L2.
